name: Mitten Extracts Disposable 2-In-1 Flip | Strawberry Gelato + Mango Tango
description:
Sweet meets tropical in this flavorful duo. Creamy strawberry gelato pairs perfectly with bright mango notes, creating a smooth and juicy experience whether you enjoy them separately or blended together.

2 Grams. Two flavors. Three modes. Total control - Flavor for taste, Balance for smooth hits, Clouds for max output.
